procedure: At each CONTRACTS §7 G-PANEL round (IC-4 2026-11-05, IC-8 2026-12-03, IC-12 2026-12-31): read the lane-14 tools/quality-rebuild-capture records for the six pilot routes at their default URLs (no ?capture=review) and append one review row per game.

deltas are per-G-PANEL asset changes: which replacement-lists.json picks shipped, visual delta vs the previous checkpoint capture (rubric axes from the lookdev record), and VRAM/draw/ready-byte movement vs tier-measurements.json.

Every pilot requires a named human sign-off (pass|fail + notes). Misses are filed as qr-ic-regression issues, attributed per game by leave-one-out: re-run the pilot with one replacement reverted; the delta isolates the offending asset.
